info.title: Triplespace REST API
info.summary: Data only Triplespace has, under rest.php/triplespace/v0 (ADR 0012 §1.3, §5).
info.description: The normative contract of the triplespace/v0 REST API. `v0` makes no stability promise yet (ADR 0005 §5). A route and its entry here change together. Every route is served per tenant base, which the request's host selects; responses are redacted for their viewer (ADR 0012 §8) and cached as ADR 0014 §6 has it: a public response carries `ETag`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, s-maxage=60` and the `Cache-Tag` of every entity it drew on, and a request whose `If-None-Match` names the `ETag` gets `304`.

get.summary: Where an entity and each of its statements come from
get.description: Which graphs hold a record for the entity, with their statement counts, sync state and history policy; the dominant graph; the graphs that assert each statement of the resolved view; the local corrections; who minted the ID; retention; the canonical ID (ADR 0003 §6, ADR 0012 §5). Fields whose projections are not built yet (cluster members, constraint results, the backlink count) are absent. A valid keyed ID that no graph holds answers with an empty provenance, as `wbgetentities` serves an empty entity for it (ADR 0009 §4).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An entity ID in any form the Action API accepts: `Q6`, `XDQ12`, `domain:wikipedia.org`, `Item:Q6`.

304.description: The client's copy, named by `If-None-Match`, is current.

400.description: Not an entity ID, or one of no registered provider.

404.description: No such entity, or one the caller may not know exists (ADR 0056 §5).

421.description: The host is not a tenant of this instance.

get.description: The credit line's parts (developer, contributors, funders), the licence and where the source of this build is, the build, the services the instance is configured to use with their states and (unless the instance's `version.services` setting withholds them) versions, the Triplespace crates and third-party components, the feature switches of the tenant (at a tenant base) or the instance (at the farm base), the entry points, the wikitext the tenant's expansion recognizes, the MediaWiki extensions that inspired features, the AI agents used, and the instance (ADR 0077 §10). `components_listed` is false for a build made without a component manifest; the component lists are then empty.

421.description: Not a tenant of this instance.

get.summary: One component's licence, copyright and notice files
get.description: The files a third-party crate, frontend package or vendored tree ships, as this build embeds them (ADR 0077 §3): what `Special:Version/License/{component}` serves.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The component's `name@version`, as `GET /version` lists it: `url@2.5.4`, `@wikimedia/codex@2.7.0`.

404.description: No component of that ID in this build.

421.description: Not a tenant of this instance.

get.summary: A change feed: recent changes, a history or contributions
get.description: Activity rows filtered by a target set (ADR 0020 §1–2; chapter 16 §4): without `target` or `actor`, the everything set, which is recent changes; with `target`, the one-target set, which is that entity's, page's, actor's or job's history; with `actor` alone, that actor's contributions. Rows are ordered by (time, partition, offset), newest first unless `dir=newer`, and paged with `next`, an opaque token the next request sends as `continue`. Every row is redacted for the viewer (ADR 0012 §8): a hidden part is named in `visibility` and absent from the row, and a row under a `read` restriction the viewer's groups do not satisfy is not returned. Mirror syncs (`kind: sync`) are left out of the everything set by default and kept in a target's history (chapter 16 §4.2); `syncs` overrides that. The related and watched sets and the stream are not served yet.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The one-target set: `{kind}:{id}` with kind `entity`, `page`, `actor`, `job` or `record`, such as `entity:Q6`, `page:12`, `actor:local:7`.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Rows by one actor, by user name or actor key: the contributions set when no `target` is given, an actor filter on the target's history otherwise.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Row kinds, `|`-separated: `edit`, `sync`, `log`, `job`, `erased`. Default: every kind but `sync` for the everything set, every kind for a target.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only rows from these graphs, `|`-separated: `local`, `pages`, `mirror/wikidata`, …; a history's source switch (chapter 19 §3.5).

parameters.name: syncs
parameters.description: `on` or `off`: whether mirror syncs are included; a shorthand on `kind`.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Entity namespaces, `|`-separated (`120`, `122`, `210`, …), or `*`.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only rows carrying this change tag.

parameters.name: job
parameters.description: Only rows written by this job.

parameters.name: exclude_actor
parameters.description: No rows by this actor (name or key).

parameters.name: log_type
parameters.description: Only log events of this type.

parameters.name: log_action
parameters.description: … and this action.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: Flag filters, `|`-separated: `bot`, `!bot`, `minor`, `!minor`, `new`, `!new`, `patrolled`, `!patrolled`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Rows at or after this time: ISO 8601 or MediaWiki's `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS`.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Rows at or before this time.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: `older` (newest first, the default) or `newer`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page: 50 by default, 500 at most.

parameters.name: continue
parameters.description: The `next` token of the previous page.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: The language of the targets' labels; `mul` and `en` are fallbacks.

Cache-Tag.description: Public responses only: `entity:{id}` for an entity's history, `activity` otherwise.

400.description: A parameter the route does not take a value of (`bad-parameter`).

421.description: The host is not a tenant of this instance (`misdirected`).

get.description: The entity's history as activity rows (ADR 0012 §5, A71; chapter 19 §3.3): every record keyed to it in any partition the tenant reads — local edits, mirror syncs and log events — newest first unless `dir=newer`, paged with `next`/`continue` as `GET /activity` is. Mirror syncs are included (`syncs` is on for a history, chapter 16 §4.2); `source` narrows the list to one graph, the source switch of chapter 19 §3.5. Until composition writes `view.entity_history`, the rows are the entity's own: cluster members' records and upstream log events are not yet merged in. An entity that does not exist, or that the viewer may not see, answers 404 alike (ADR 0056 §5).

parameters.description: An entity ID in any form the Action API accepts: `Q6`, `XDQ12`, `domain:wikipedia.org`, `Item:Q6`.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Row kinds, `|`-separated: `edit`, `sync`, `log`, `job`, `erased`. Default: every kind but `sync` for the everything set, every kind for a target.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only rows from these graphs, `|`-separated: `local`, `pages`, `mirror/wikidata`, …; a history's source switch (chapter 19 §3.5).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Rows at or after this time: ISO 8601 or MediaWiki's `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS`.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Rows at or before this time.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: `older` (newest first, the default) or `newer`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page: 50 by default, 500 at most.

parameters.name: continue
parameters.description: The `next` token of the previous page.

parameters.name: lang

200.description: One page of the entity's history.

400.description: The ID does not parse (`invalid-entity-id`), or a parameter the route does not take a value of (`bad-parameter`).

404.description: No such entity, or none the viewer may see (`entity-not-found`).

421.description: The host is not a tenant of this instance (`misdirected`).

get.summary: The structured diff of one change set
get.description: One record of the entity's history (ADR 0012 §5, §7; chapter 18 §5.1). For a local record: the change set's operation as stored, the diff between the local graph's state before and after it (terms and sitelinks as keyed lists; each property the change touched as a group with its unchanged statements for context), the corrections and retention that changed, the revision's facts and the previous local revision. For a mirror record (a `put`): the upstream versions on either side, the `changes` summary the sync stored and the state after; the previous state is not held under the `latest` policy. Past local states are read by folding the subject's local records until `view.entity_revision` exists (ADR 0083 §4). The effect block of chapter 18 §5.1 and the checkpoint are not served yet (`effect: null`, `integrity.checkpoint: null`).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An entity ID in any form the Action API accepts.

404.description: No such entity (`entity-not-found`), or no such record of it, or one the viewer may not see (`change-not-found`).

421.description: The host is not a tenant of this instance (`misdirected`).

get.summary: Two states of one source, compared
get.description: The diff between two local revisions of the entity (ADR 0012 §5; chapter 19 §3.7): the same shape as one change's diff, between the states after `from` and after `to`. Only `source=local` can be compared yet; a mirror's earlier states are not held under the `latest` policy, and `full` mirrors wait for their write path (`ts-compare-source`).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An entity ID in any form the Action API accepts.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The graph: `local` (the default and, for now, the only one).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: A local revision ID.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: A local revision ID.

400.description: The ID does not parse (`invalid-entity-id`); `from` or `to` is missing or not a number (`missing-parameter`, `bad-parameter`); a source that cannot be compared (`ts-compare-source`).

404.description: No such entity (`entity-not-found`), or a revision that is not a local revision of it (`revision-not-found`).

421.description: The host is not a tenant of this instance (`misdirected`).

id.description: The entity ID in canonical form.

canonical.description: The canonical ID of the entity's identity cluster (ADR 0004 §4); the ID itself when it is in none.

dominant.description: The graph that asserts the most statements; a tie goes to the earlier graph, local first. Absent when no graph asserts any.

graphs.description: Each graph that holds a record for the entity, local first.

statements.description: Keyed by the statement ID of the resolved view.

corrections.description: The tenant's corrections of mirrored statements (ADR 0002 §7), keyed by the statement ID they correct.

adopted_from.description: The wiki the tenant was adopted from (ADR 0035).

type.description: The keyed type; a keyed ID names the thing itself and is minted by no one (ADR 0017 §1).

statements.description: How many statements the graph asserts.

synced_at.description: When the graph's current record for the entity was written.

upstream_version.description: The upstream version that record carries, for a mirror.

graphs.description: The graphs that assert a member, in graph order.

members.description: The member statements' own IDs, in graph order (ADR 0004 §8).

path.description: Vendored trees only: where the tree is in the repository

source.description: Where the corresponding source is; null for a modified build whose instance names no `instance.source_url`

commercial.description: Also available under a commercial licence from Scatter LLC

providers.description: The providers the instance mirrors, which the tenant reads

set.description: Whether the tenant or the instance sets it; otherwise `value` is the default
The target set served: `everything`, `{kind, id}` for one target, or `{actor}` for contributions.

kinds.description: The row kinds the page covers.

next.description: The token of the next page; absent on the last.

sources.description: The graphs the page is narrowed to; empty for all.

time.description: When the event happened at its source.

revid.description: The global revision ID of a change set.

logid.description: The global log ID of an event.

target.description: Absent for a record with no target.

member.description: The cluster member the record is keyed to, or the revision a record target names.

actor.description: `{hidden: true}` when the actor is hidden from the viewer.

visibility.description: The parts hidden from the viewer.

EntityDiff.description: The differences between two states of one source (chapter 18 §5.1).

claims.description: Each property with a changed statement: its whole group, in the order of the state after, removed statements last.

before.description: The statement before, in the storage form.

StateChange.description: What changed in the local graph's state beside the entity: corrections (rank overrides and suppressions), retention, a redirect.

previous.description: The previous local revision, `{revid, offset}`, or null.

operation.description: The change set's operation as stored (local records).

diff.description: The structured diff (local records), or null.

changes.description: A sync's stored summary (mirror records), or null.

after.description: A mirror record's state after, in the storage form.
